title: Machine Learning Engineer - Geospatial AI
description: DataCorp AI is building the next generation of geospatial AI models for satellite imagery analysis. We are looking for an ML Engineer to train and deploy computer vision models for land use classification, change detection, and object detection from satellite data. Stack: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, AWS SageMaker, Docker, Kubernetes. Required: 3+ years ML engineering experience, strong Python, experience with geospatial data (raster/vector) is a major plus. Publications in CVPR/ICCV/ECCV or similar a plus.

screening.summary: Exciting geospatial AI role with strong ML engineering focus, high growth potential, modern cloud stack.

ranking.thinking_trace: Strong ML/tech match (PyTorch, TF, K8s), geospatial AI domain alignment, high growth potential, modern MLOps stack.
